scripts.build:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.copy:static: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/static', 'dist/static', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build:package: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); delete pkg.devDependencies; delete pkg.scripts; fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));"
scripts.build:install: cd dist && npm install --production --loglevel=error --no-fund --no-audit && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('package.json', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('package-lock.json', { force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run copy:static && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:package
